note: Why a catalogue row is still planned, as the library panel shows it (greyed, with this reason). Reasons come from the batch-1 packages' own notes (DECISIONS P4-P10a and BATCH1_BUILD_PLAN P15). A row not listed here gets its batch's line, or its recipe backend's line, or the default.
batch: Planned for batch {batch}: not built yet.

backend.nature: The nature family draws it in its own scene; its numbers come in a later step.
backend.character: The character family draws it; its numbers aren't set yet.

groups.reason: Needs a body-region mask (belly, face, legs, bands) that no recipe has yet.
Painted stripes and lining need a region mask or a decal.
Seams and mixed plates need regions: two materials on one surface.
Flesh fused with metal is two materials, not one.
Copper traces need a trace pattern no recipe has.
A flash where it is hit needs an impact input.
Flashing colour patches need a hue pattern the gem recipe lacks.
The pulse needs a time term the gem recipe lacks.

rows.skin.trait.freckled: The skin family has no freckle field yet.
rows.skin.trait.elder: The skin family has no age spots yet.
rows.eye.brown_dark: The iris's centre ring can't be set per material yet, so a brown eye reads hazel.
rows.cloth.denim.indigo: The cloth family has no twill weave yet.
rows.cloth.wool.blanket: Blanket stripes need a stripe pattern the cloth family lacks.
rows.tool.rope.hemp: A rope's twist is geometry, not a weave.
rows.glass.crystal.cut: Cut facets and a rainbow sparkle need a faceted pattern the glass recipe lacks; it draws as plain clear glass.
rows.jewel.paste: Cut facets need a faceted pattern the glass recipe lacks; it draws as plain clear glass.
rows.water.ocean.open: Rolling waves and whitecaps need open-sea foam the water recipe lacks; it draws as flat blue.
rows.dragonfly.wing: A dragonfly wing needs veins running along it, a dense net of small cells and see-through; the wing pattern fans out like a shell.
rows.cloth.chiffon: Chiffon's sheerness needs see-through (the blend pass); drawn opaque it reads as pink silk.
rows.food.meat.bacon: Bacon's fat streaks need a stripe pattern the flesh recipe lacks; its marbling makes blobs, so it reads as raw meat.
rows.paper.map: Coastlines and lettering need a printed picture (a decal); the paper's motifs read as wallpaper.
rows.paper.playing_card: Printed pips and a card face need a printed picture (a decal); the paper's motifs read as wallpaper, not a playing card.
rows.paper.paper_lantern: A paper lantern needs a glow that works outside the nature scene; on the viewer ball it is plain red paper. Filed for batch 10.
rows.ground.ice.sheet_road: Black ice needs a near-black, glossy, slightly see-through road sheet; the ice recipe draws it as pale blue-grey slate (it lightens a dark tint) and the ground recipe is not see-through. Filed for batch 10.
rows.food.beer: Beer needs a foam top on the liquid preview; drawn as plain see-through gold glass it reads as honey. Filed for batch 10.
rows.food.cake: Cake is white icing over soft sponge: it needs a cut-slice preview that shows both; on the ball the icing alone reads as a plain white ball. Filed for batch 10.
rows.food.milk: Milk is an opaque white liquid: it needs a liquid preview (a glass or a pour); on the ball it reads as a plain white ball. Filed for batch 10.
rows.food.stew: Stew needs chunks (meat, carrot, potato) sitting in a glossy liquid; the water liquid draws a plain brown ball, and the organic recipe's round spots in one colour read as a spotted sweet. Filed for batch 10.
